#114 IV02-B: analyse raw CSV Profiler captures of the timing suite (system Python 3 + numpy).

    python Content/Python/WhispersTests/IV02/analyze_runs.py

Reads Saved/IV02/runs/timing_r<rep>_<cfg>/csv/*.csv and writes Saved/IV02/analysis/summary.json and
summary.md. Rules (stated once, applied everywhere):
- Statistics come from raw per-frame rows; no frame is discarded. Percentiles are nearest-rank on the
  pooled raw samples of the stated set; percentiles are never averaged.
- A counter missing from a capture is reported as "N/A (not emitted)", never 0.
- CPU thread times and GPU time overlap; they are never summed. The bound regime is the largest of
  GameThreadTime / RenderThreadTime / RHIThreadTime / GPUTime medians; "contested" if the top two are
  within 10 %.
- Paired delta = metric(config X, view v, repetition r) - metric(config A, view v, repetition r).
- Stutter counts: frames > 2 x run median, > 33.3 ms and > 50 ms.
